en: Have you a Raichu? I'd gladly swap my Electrode for one.
A Raichu! Splendid. Esphere will give you a shock now and then, mind.
That isn't a Raichu. A Raichu is what I want.
Fair enough. Bring a Raichu next time, and we'll talk.
Raichu has made itself at home in the lab. How is Esphere?
I'd love a Venonat. I'd swap my Tangela for one.
A Venonat! Thank you. Tangeny's vines get tangled easily, so mind them.
That isn't a Venonat. I only want a Venonat.
Oh. If you come across a Venonat, do come back.
My Venonat has a lovely pair of eyes. I hope Tangeny is well.
